text.p0: Over the last few months the team worked on improving every detail of the experience.
text.p1: Feedback from the community was key to defining this year's priorities.
text.p2: We learned that small constant changes are worth more than one big isolated overhaul.
text.p3: That is why we decided to share our progress openly, step by step and without shortcuts.
text.p4: Starting next month there will be new options available for all users.
text.p5: If you want to help, your feedback is always welcome and we read it carefully.
text.p6: We also renewed customer service to reduce waiting times.
text.p7: Thank you for being with us: the best is yet to come.

comment.c0: Great piece, exactly what I needed to read.
comment.c1: I disagree with the third paragraph, but thanks for sharing.
comment.c2: Will there be a second part? I wanted more.
comment.c3: I shared it with my family and they loved it.
comment.c4: Excellent, you can tell there is work behind it.
comment.c5: I have a question: does this apply in other regions too?
comment.c6: Amazing, I did not know that. Thanks.
comment.c7: A bit short, but clear and to the point.

faq.q0: How can I create an account?
faq.a0: From the sign-up form, by filling in your basic details.
faq.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a1: We accept credit cards, debit cards and bank transfer.
faq.a2: Yes, up to 24 hours after confirming it, at no cost.
faq.a3: Between 2 and 5 business days depending on your location.
faq.q4: How do I change my password?
faq.a4: From your profile, in the security section.
faq.a5: Yes, Monday to Friday from 9 am to 6 pm.
faq.q6: Do you issue invoices to companies?
faq.a6: Yes, just request it at the time of purchase.
faq.a7: You can update them at any time from your account.
faq.q8: How do I close my account?
faq.a8: Write to us from the contact form and we will handle it.
faq.q9: Where can I see the status of my request?
faq.a9: In the activity section of your account.
